decisions.reason: After two years without visible website presence and with weak differentiation from widely available conferencing tools, management now has relatively little strategic reason to keep defending this peripheral service.

This offer fits the firm's core metro, data-centre and cloud-connectivity strengths and had early adoption, so management is likely to continue it and treat reduced visibility as broader portfolio integration.

Optical spectrum connectivity is tightly aligned with the firm's fibre-based high-bandwidth direction and was launched with visible commitment, which makes reversal less likely even if it is no longer marketed separately.

A voice number ordering portal supports the stated move toward software-defined, real-time provisioning, so management is inclined to retain the capability and view its lower visibility as incorporation into customer systems.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony product with the weakest fit to the firm's announced strategic direction, and its prolonged absence from marketing makes continued commitment hard to justify.

Despite fading standalone visibility, direct voice network connection remains close to the firm's established enterprise voice and network base, so management would still be somewhat inclined to retain it within broader service bundles.
